nativeAssetCrossJoin.scope: Overapproximation of all native literal data/* source paths plus their literal Lua/XML dependencies. Literal native references are not automatically normal-game roots; this search finds candidate joins to trace. Material definitions and biome registries are stopped to avoid interpreting definition inclusion as creation.
nativeAssetCrossJoin.entryClosureFinding: The native exact-root overapproximation finds only spark_player. Relevant broad directory prefixes preload templates rather than create entities; native effect-prefix source and spliced-image domains are closed; the polymorph animal registry rejects the candidate aluminium _physics files. Therefore the concrete native initial-asset question remaining from this corpus is the co-op activation of spark_player.

polymorphRegistryJoin.sourceFinding: Both boss_limbs_physics variants lack polymorphable_NOT, so source tags alone were insufficient.
polymorphRegistryJoin.nativeFinding: Native random-polymorph registry rejects the substring _physics; both aluminium producer filenames match that explicit filter. Directory recursion details cannot reintroduce a filename already rejected by this filter.

preload.finding: The entities/items/projectiles/buildings/props and gfx/vegetation/particles directory prefixes feed template preloading. The XML branch obtains EntityFactory templates; it does not invoke EntityCreate or world placement. Template presence is not entity creation.

effects.finding: The prefix forms effect_<lowercased GAME_EFFECT enum>.xml, with explicit overrides. Conservatively scanning every existing misc/effect_*.xml and literal dependencies finds no remaining candidate material producer.

splicedImages.finding: Regardless of the filename suffix construction, every inspected PNG/PLZ under data/biome_impl/spliced/ has no RGB match for any original62 candidate, including alpha-zero pixels.
